whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Old Champaran Meat House,

I noticed your iconic restaurant has an incredible 7,700+ reviews on Google in Lodipur, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and direct delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme authentic Ahuna/Champaran meat specialities menu, direct WhatsApp order/table booking, aur location guide integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/champaran

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Old Champaran Meat House, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We noticed aapke 7,700+ Google reviews hain Patna mein, aur humne usko highlight karne ke liye ek dedicated mobile page banaya hai with digital menu and direct WhatsApp ordering. Aapko overall look kaisa laga? Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
